title: ActiveConstantPowerLoad
description: Parameters of 12-states active power load based on the paper, "Dynamic Stability of a Microgrid With an Active Load." It has no bus of its own: exactly one static injection device, with the same name, names it in its `dynamic_injector` property, and that device supplies the rest of its data.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

name.description: Name of the dynamic injection. Must equal the name of the static injection device that names it in `dynamic_injector`.

kpv.description: Proportional constant for Voltage Control block

kiv.description: Integral constant for Voltage Control block

kpc.description: Proportional constant for Current Control block

kic.description: Integral constant for Current Control block

is_filter_differential.description: Boolean to decide if filter states are differential or algebraic

base_power.description: Base power for the per-unit parameters of this model. Usually equal to the `base_power` of the static injection device that names this model. Units: MVA.
